knowledge_point.title: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations

question.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}19y &=21-x \\ 21x-17y+1 &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+19y &=21 \\ 21x-17y &=-1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}1 & 19 \\ 21 & -17\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 19 & 21 \\ 21 & -17 & -1\end{array}\right]
$$

question.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}7x-y &=7 \\ 22x &=-12\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}7x-y &=7 \\ 22x+0y &=-12\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}7 & -1 \\ 22 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}7 & -1 & 7 \\ 22 & 0 & -12\end{array}\right]
$$
